sentence: On 8 October 2026 the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved atezolizumab (Tecentriq, Genentech) with a fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin for adjuvant treatment of stage III mismatch repair deficient (dMMR) colon cancer.
note: Search text: approved October 8, 2026; atezolizumab with fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin for adjuvant treatment.

sentence: The approval covers adults and children aged two years and older.
note: Search text: adult and pediatric patients two years of age and older.

sentence: A subcutaneous form, Tecentriq Hybreza, is approved with the same chemotherapy for patients aged 12 years and older who weigh at least 40 kg.
note: Search text: Hybreza ... 12 years and older who weigh 40 kg or more.

sentence: The FDA notes that ATOMIC enrolled 711 adults and one paediatric patient.
note: Search text: enrolled 711 adults and one pediatric patient (verifier caveat).

sentence: Adjuvant treatment is given after surgery to lower the chance of the cancer returning.
The FDA says the approval rests on the ATOMIC trial, a randomised, open-label, active-controlled study in people with stage III dMMR colon cancer after complete removal of the primary tumour.
note: Search text: ATOMIC (NCT02912559) randomized, open-label, active-controlled; Stage III dMMR after complete resection of primary tumor.

sentence: This is a US decision; availability in the UK is decided separately by the MHRA and NICE.
